title: Staged close-friends list is one Option not matched to the request
trigger: Save the close-friends list twice quickly (A then B) and let the first request fail.
effect: close_friends_pending holds only the latest list; A's error clears B's staged ids, so B's ok applies nothing and the list on screen stays stale although the server has B.
fix: Stage the list on the PendingRequest (or a map by RequestId) and apply it on that request's ok.

title: A failed send of the next search page throws away all search results
trigger: Scroll a public story search to its end and trigger Load more when the sender refuses the request.
effect: send_story_search_page calls clear_story_search on any send error, so the open results panel and its pages vanish instead of showing a retryable error.
fix: On a send error settle the page as Failed (search.error, loading cleared) and keep the pages.

title: show_from_pinned shows the list but does not mark comments read or clear has=WithUnread
trigger: Comments toggle shows the dot (WithNew); click a pinned comment (list opens); close the list again with the toggle.
effect: last_read_id and has stay stale, so on_messages (hidden) computes 'unread' from old ids and the dot can come back for comments already seen when has changes.
fix: Make show_from_pinned go through the same transition as toggle to Shown.

title: getChatsToPostStories error is written into the eligibility check_error
trigger: Open the story composer while the Post-as chats request fails and press Post at the same time (check_sent = true).
effect: frame_upkeep reads check_error.is_some() as the eligibility answer, so the composer reports a check failure with the post-as message and stops waiting for the real canPostStory answer, which then clears the line.
fix: Give the post-as list its own Fetch<Vec<i64>> error.

title: set_donors zeroes committed_stars for any donors snapshot, including one older than the commit
trigger: Tap Stars, commit, and a getLiveStoryTopDonors answer or updateLiveStoryTopDonors that predates the commit lands.
effect: The Stars button total and 'your Stars' drop by the committed amount for a moment until the next donors update counts them.
fix: Keep committed batches with the request that sent them and retire a batch only when a donors snapshot after its answer arrives.

title: AddPendingReaction error after the pending Stars were already committed leaves committed_stars inflated; CommitPendingReactions error zeroes all batches
trigger: Tap Stars on a live story, the addPendingLiveStoryReaction error arrives after the 5.5 s commit tick (slow network), or two commits are in flight and one fails.
effect: The Stars button total keeps showing Stars that were not added (until a donors update), or drops other committed batches from the total.
fix: Track each batch with its request id (AddPending/Commit carry stars) and undo exactly that batch's stars from whichever bucket holds it.

title: One failed calendar page ends paging for the box for good
trigger: Open Jump to date on a media tab, scroll to an older month while the getChatMessageCalendar page fails (timeout, flood wait, offline) or the send fails (connect/search/chat_search.rs:437).
effect: fail() sets exhausted = true, so older months show no highlighted days and never page again until the box is reopened.
fix: Model paging as an enum Idle/Loading/Failed{retry}/Exhausted; only a 404-like empty page is Exhausted, a failure stays retryable.

title: A failed searchChatMembers for the @ menu leaves the search stuck on its query
trigger: Type @ab in a group while searchChatMembers fails (flood wait, no rights). Retype or keep the same query.
effect: There is no error arm for SearchMentionMembers: MentionSearch.request stays Some forever and search_mentions returns early for the same chat and query, so no retry is made until the text changes.
fix: Add a SearchMentionMembers error arm that clears request (and the query so it is asked again), or make the stage Fetch<Vec<UserId>> keyed by the query.

title: Custom emoji cache cap clears entries stored earlier in the same batch
trigger: Answer with stickers while the cache holds 512 entries and several new ids
effect: Each new id past the cap clears the cache, including stickers just inserted from this answer, so emoji just fetched vanish and are refetched
fix: Evict once before the loop (or evict only entries not requested now) instead of clearing per sticker.

title: fail_story_viewers matches by story, so a stale error from an earlier request of the same story fails the current fetch
trigger: Close and reopen viewers panel for the same story while the old request is lost/errors
effect: Panel shows an error while a newer request is still loading, or the newer answer later overwrites it
fix: Compare the request id carried by the Loading stage.

title: Story insights forwards accept any page for the same story, including a stale append
trigger: Open story statistics, load more public forwards, switch to another story's statistics and back while the page is in flight.
effect: accept_public_forwards matches by (chat, story) only and extends the fresh list, so a page from the earlier visit lands without page 1; a reopen while a page is in flight also never sets forwards_loading on the new state.
fix: Keep the forwards fetch as one value with the request id (Idle | Loading{request,offset} | Failed) and accept only its answer.

title: "Page is loading" is checked by op label only, not by chat, so paging for one chat is skipped while another chat's page loads
trigger: Open chat A's story page and scroll the archive to its end (getChatArchivedStories in flight, page_op Checking 'loading archived stories'); before it answers, open chat B's story page and scroll its archive to the end. Or start an album mutation while a page loads.
effect: ui/story_albums/paging.rs story_page_loading() matches op.label == story_page_op_label(purpose), so B's next page is not asked until A's answer clears the op (self-corrects on the next scroll); a mutation started mid-load makes the load look finished and the same page is asked twice.
fix: Key the load-in-flight check by (chat, purpose, request) instead of the label string.

title: Fact-check expansion is per window, not per chat
trigger: Open a chat in the main window and in its own chat window, expand a fact check in one.
effect: fact_check_expanded lives in each window's MessageUi, so the other window shows the same fact check collapsed; the set also only grows and is not cleared on chat change.
fix: Move the set into ChatUi (per chat, replaced whole on chat change), or key it by account chat in OnScreen.

title: Accept / Reject on a sharing request has no in-flight stage
trigger: Click Accept (or Reject) twice quickly, or click Accept then Reject before TDLib's update removes the buttons.
effect: answer_sharing_request sends every click to the driver; the buttons stay until the message update arrives, so two answers (possibly contradictory) go out and a second error toast can appear.
fix: A per-message enum SharingAnswer { Open, Sending(approve) } in the chat's ChatUi that hides the buttons on the first click and returns to Open on error.

title: Frame-strip ffmpeg cuts keep running while Quill is locked or the viewer is paused/hidden
trigger: open cover picker, then lock with the passcode (or minimise) before the 8 strip frames are cut
effect: background ffmpeg work on the story clip continues under the lock until all frames are done (only a closed/replaced picker stops it)
fix: gate the loop on lock/active state or cut frames from a task owned by the picker that the lock cancels

title: picker_load_near_end skips the archive_asked guard, so an empty or short page re-asks on every scroll; in demo mode it sets a note every time
trigger: scroll the picker grid near its end when the server total exceeds what it returns (hidden stories)
effect: a request (or in demo a status note) per scroll event
fix: use the same Asked/load_due guard as story_archive_more

title: stats_asked and found_asked (and the page asked guards) are never reset; the automatic first look is skipped when the list length repeats
trigger: view statistics of story A (10 shares loaded), then story B whose first page also has 10 and does not fill the panel; or run two story searches with equal first-page sizes
effect: next page is not requested until the reader scrolls (Asked::reset exists but is unused here)
fix: reset Asked and scroll handles when the viewed story or search changes (hold them in the per-item value)

title: stealth_toast lives in StoryUi, not StoryViewerUi, so a toast survives the viewer closing
trigger: enable stealth in the viewer, close the viewer within 4 s and open another story
effect: the previous 'Stealth mode on' toast shows again over the new viewer until its 4 s deadline
fix: move the toast into StoryViewerUi so release_story_viewer drops it

title: Viewers panel shows a loading spinner whenever next_offset is set, even after an error, and the error has no retry
trigger: fail a viewers page, keep the panel open
effect: error text and 'Loading viewers' spinner are shown together; no Retry button despite the comment above fail_story_viewers
fix: same Fetch-like enum; spinner only for Loading, Retry for Failed

title: send_live_comment and live_story_admin read calls.story_stream without matching it to the watched live story's call id
trigger: Switch live stories or rejoin so story_stream holds a different call than stories.live.group_call_id for a moment, then press Send.
effect: price and admin are taken from the other call (the composer filters by call.id == live.group_call_id, send does not), so the free/paid path and moderation controls can differ from what the field showed.
fix: One accessor `live_call()` that returns the story_stream only when its id equals the live story's group_call_id, used by composer, send and admin checks.

title: Ban User still runs after the comment delete failed
trigger: In the live comment delete box tick Ban User and confirm while delete_live_story_comment returns Err.
effect: `banned` is computed regardless of `deleted`, so the sender is banned/blocked although the comment was not deleted; the box has already closed (delete taken) and only a generic note shows.
fix: Run the ban only after the delete was accepted, and keep the box open (or report which step failed) on Err.

title: A finished voice/video reply closes whatever reply row is open now, not the one it came from
trigger: Record a voice reply for story A, press Send (encoder finishes off-thread), step to story B and open its reply row before the encoder finishes.
effect: finish_story_reply_media calls end_story_reply, closing and cancelling B's row and recording; the reply is correctly addressed to A.
fix: Pass the (chat, story) the recording was for and end the row only if it is still the current reply target.
